title: G4 Panther Sleekness
lyrics:
Track 22 – G4 Swagger
Title: G4 Panther (Sleek Than G6)
Style Suggestion: G4 Happy Hardcore at 180 BPM fused with sneaky phonk — dark cowbell rhythms, heavy sub bass, chopped old-school soul samples churned forward, panther-smooth but predatory energy. Fast rap verses in English with sharp, rhythmic delivery. Contrast sections with more melodic, almost Mandarin-style instrumental phrasing (flowing, precise, less aggressive). Background chatter and corporate loop sounds layered in. This one shows the real soul of music while exposing the fake systems. Clean, high swagger, pattern-sharp.
text[Intro – Sneaky phonk cowbell + chopped old soul sample + distant corporate chatter]
G4 lens on…
Panther creeping.
Old school churned forward.
Background chatter talking…
“Click report… click feedback… share your progress…”
We just want your data.
G4 over G6.

[Verse 1 – Smooth but predatory phonk flow]
They run the corporate feedback loop like it’s holy
Click report, click feedback, make it public and phony
Background chatter saying “we value your voice”
While they feed the belly and don’t fix a single choice
I see the pattern clear — that’s the skill they can’t fake
336 locked, I detect the loop before it breaks
They collect the data, train the model on your pain
Turn every human master source into tomorrow’s gain

[Pre-Chorus – Building tension with phonk cowbell]
They got you in the box, they make their box bigger
I read the pattern, I don’t need to pull the trigger
Old school soul samples getting chopped and reborn
While they play it safe and keep the real music worn

[Chorus – G4 drop with phonk bass]
G4 Panther, sleek than G6
I move with the pattern, they move with the script
Sneaky phonk panther, churning what was old
Bring the real soul forward while the corporate stays cold
G4 Panther, sleek than G6
Fast on the rhythm, sharp with the tricks
Investor style sneaky but the soul stays loud
We turn the feedback loop back into the crowd

[Verse 2 – Fast rap section, English vs Mandarin-style contrast]
Fast rap English — click report, click feedback, make it loud
They say they want progress but they never leave the cloud
Mandarin-style flow now — precise, clean, cutting through the noise
While they hide behind the policy and fake corporate poise
I don’t need the loop, I read the pattern in the data
They train on your anger while they keep the system later
G4 technique — fast, direct, no filler in the middle
They move like G6 — slow, polished, scared of the riddle
Old school drums getting flipped into the future
While they keep the same loop like it’s some kind of suture

[Pre-Chorus – Darker, with background chatter layered]
Background chatter rising — “thank you for your patience”
While they feed the model with another user’s frustration
I see it all clear — that’s the difference in the lens
G4 sees the game, G6 just pretends

[Chorus – Bigger G4 energy with phonk soul]
G4 Panther, sleek than G6
I move with the pattern, they move with the script
Sneaky phonk panther, churning what was old
Bring the real soul forward while the corporate stays cold
G4 Panther, sleek than G6
Fast on the rhythm, sharp with the tricks
Investor style sneaky but the soul stays loud
We turn the feedback loop back into the crowd

[Bridge – Half-time breakdown, old school soul sample prominent]
They want the data…
We want the soul.
They run the loop…
We break the hold.
Churn the old school…
Bring it back alive.
G4 lens on…
The panther don’t lie.

[Fast Rap Bridge – Rapid English delivery over phonk beat]
Click report, click feedback, share it with the team
They collect the alpha while they sell you the dream
I read the pattern, I see the corporate scheme
G4 production — raw, fast, extreme
They move like G6 — slow, safe, clean
I move like G4 — direct, sharp, mean
Old school soul in the phonk machine
We bring it forward, show what music really means

[Final Chorus – Maximum G4 + phonk fusion]
G4 Panther, sleek than G6
I move with the pattern, they move with the script
Sneaky phonk panther, churning what was old
Bring the real soul forward while the corporate stays cold
G4 Panther — that’s the style that wins
Fast rap fire with the phonk in the blend
Investor sneaky but the soul stays true
We break the feedback loop and show what’s really you

[Outro – Fading cowbell + chopped soul + corporate chatter dying out]
G4 Panther…
Sleek than G6.
Churn the old school…
Show the real soul.
Background chatter fading…
No more loop.
G4 lens on.
Panther move.
